title: reconcile-shadowed-credits-caused-by-async-fallback-retry-coalescing
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Multiple enterprise customers (Hosted + Dedicated + Private) reported invoice line-item deltas where credits applied during retries were not reflected in aggregate monthly bills. Investigation shows a class of requests that triggered an async fallback path and subsequent retry coalescing into a single upstream request produced internal 'shadow' credit records that were never reconciled to the tenant's ledger. The symptom: customers see correct per-request logs but monthly invoice shows missing credits (negative variance) for retry-related events. This ticket tracks root-cause analysis, a corrective migration to reconcile affected accounts, and a fix to prevent recurrence.
observed_symptoms: customers report missing credits on monthly invoice
per-request logs show credit issued then marked shadowed
reconciler exports don't include shadowed records
reproduction_steps: 1) Configure client with aggressive retry + prefer-fallback routing (simulate transient node failure)
2) Issue a short burst of streaming requests that trigger fallback routing and client retry coalescing
3) Observe token credits in request logs (request-level) and compare to ledger export for the same period
4) Run reconciler job and confirm shadowed records are excluded from final rollup
analysis: Root cause: async fallback code path creates a transient 'shadow_credit' record in the retry coordinator which is intended to be promoted to the canonical ledger on success, but a race when coalescing retries sometimes marks the record as 'orphaned' and the compensating promotion never runs.
The reconciler pipeline ignores 'orphaned' markers to avoid double-counting; as a result, legitimate credits are dropped rather than attributed.
Edge conditions amplified in Dedicated and Private due to slower inter-service RPCs and different backoff timings — explains higher customer reports in those environments.
Not related to KMS or invoice export formatting; this is an attribution gap between in-flight retry coordinator state and final ledger commit.
proposed_fix: 1) Fix retry coordinator: ensure idempotent promotion flow for shadow_credit records with a compare-and-swap (CAS) commit so promotion cannot be skipped when coalescing occurs.
2) Update reconciler to include a secondary scan for orphaned shadow_credit within a sliding window and surface candidates for re-promotion instead of dropping them silently.
3) Add safety unit/integration tests that simulate retry coalescing races across RPC timeouts and varying backoffs.
4) Backfill: run a targeted migration to promote eligible shadow_credit records for affected date ranges and customers; generate a reconciliation report for billing team.
5) Add monitoring: alert when reconciler drop-rate > 0.1% or when number of orphaned shadow_credit > threshold per hour.
rollout_plan: Patch release to retry coordinator (canary on Hosted with 5% traffic)
Monitor metrics for commit success and orphaned count for 48 hours
If stable, deploy to Dedicated pools with staged node-by-node rollouts
Private: publish patch and migration runbook for customer self-hosted upgrade; offer support-assisted migration for affected customers
Run backfill migration after core fix is live to ensure ledger state consistency
testing_plan: Unit tests: CAS promotion logic and idempotency
Integration tests: end-to-end simulate retries + coalescing with mocked RPC latencies
Regression tests: reconciler scanning and promotion path included in nightly pipeline
Load test: ensure promotion rate holds under bursty traffic similar to customer reports
migration_runbook: 1) Identify affected tenants by scanning 'shadow_credit' table between 2025-01-01 and 2025-02-28
2) Verify for each candidate that a successful upstream charge exists and that promoting will not double-credit (idempotency checks)
3) Run promotion in small batches with transactional commit and record audit row
4) Generate CSV of migrated tenants and credit deltas for billing team's review
5) Schedule invoice amendment window with Finance for customers requiring retroactive credits
